name: muslim
description: A Claude Code mod for Muslim developers.

thikr.title: Thikr line
thikr.description: Show tasabih in place of Claude's working words

thikrSpeed.title: Thikr speed
thikrSpeed.description: auto (1s + 0.5s per word), or whole seconds per phrase from 1 to 60

tashkeel.title: Tashkeel
tashkeel.description: Show diacritics on Arabic on desktop and other non-terminal surfaces

thikrEnd.title: Thikr end-of-turn line
thikrEnd.description: Show تَمَّ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ when a turn ends

thikrMode.title: Thikr mode
thikrMode.description: all: every group in turn; salawat: one salawat on the Prophet ﷺ for each whole turn

athkar.title: Athkar
athkar.description: Morning and evening athkar above the prompt, to read and count

athkarStyle.title: Athkar style
athkarStyle.description: sky: a sky that follows the time of day; frame: plain

color.title: Main color
color.description: The main color of the whole mod

salahShow.title: Show pray line
salahShow.description: always: next pray all day; a number: only that many minutes before a pray, counting down (e.g. 20); off: hidden

salahAthan.title: Pray call
salahAthan.description: Show حان وقت صلاة … for 15 minutes once a pray comes in

salahPlace.title: Pray place
salahPlace.description: name; latitude, longitude; time zone; country, e.g. Munich, Germany; 48.14, 11.58; Europe/Berlin; DE. Empty until set up

salahMethod.title: Pray calculation method
salahMethod.description: auto uses the place's country's own method; or name an authority's Fajr and Isha angles

salahAdjust.title: Pray minutes
salahAdjust.description: Any whole number of minutes added to Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha, e.g. 0 0 0 90 0 -120
